title: Jyotirlinga Trail: 4 Days in Ujjain, Omkareshwar & Maheshwar
card_points: Mahakal Lok and the Narmada ghats
overview: A short, rewarding circuit in Madhya Pradesh that covers two of the twelve Jyotirlingas — Mahakaleshwar in Ujjain and Omkareshwar on an island in the Narmada — along with the ghats of Maheshwar.
Ideal for a long weekend, with a private vehicle from Indore, a tour manager, comfortable stays and all meals included. We can help you apply for the early-morning Bhasma Aarti at Mahakaleshwar.

highlights.title: Mahakaleshwar
highlights.text: Jyotirlinga of Ujjain and the Mahakal Lok corridor

highlights.title: Omkareshwar
highlights.text: Jyotirlinga on Mandhata island in the Narmada

highlights.title: Ekatma Dham
highlights.text: The 108-ft Statue of Oneness of Adi Shankaracharya

highlights.title: Maheshwar
highlights.text: Ahilya Fort and the Narmada ghats

itinerary.title: Indore → Ujjain
itinerary.subtitle: Mahakal · Overnight: Ujjain
itinerary.intro: Pick-up in Indore and drive to Ujjain (about 1.5 hours).

activities.title: Mahakal Lok
activities.text: The temple corridor with murals and sculptures from Shiva’s stories.

activities.title: Mahakaleshwar darshan & Ram Ghat aarti
activities.text: On the Shipra river. Dinner and overnight stay.

activities.title: Bhasma Aarti (if booked)
activities.text: Requires advance online booking and is subject to availability.

activities.title: Drive to Omkareshwar
activities.text: About three hours. Dinner and overnight stay.

activities.title: Omkareshwar & Mamleshwar darshan
activities.text: Cross to Mandhata island by bridge or boat.

activities.title: Ekatma Dham
activities.text: Statue of Oneness of Adi Shankaracharya.

activities.title: Maheshwar
activities.text: Ahilya Fort, the ghats and Maheshwari weavers.

activities.title: Drive to Indore
activities.text: Sarafa night food market (optional). Overnight stay.

activities.title: Khajrana Ganesh Temple & Rajwada
activities.text: Then drop-off at Indore airport or railway station.

good_to_know.title: Dress code
good_to_know.text: Traditional or modest clothing is recommended at all temples. Footwear is removed before entering.

good_to_know.title: What to carry
good_to_know.text: A valid photo ID, comfortable walking shoes, a water bottle and any regular medication.

good_to_know.title: Physical activity
good_to_know.text: Some shrines involve steps or hill climbs. Tell us about mobility needs and we’ll plan accordingly.

good_to_know.title: Best time to visit
good_to_know.text: October to March is the most comfortable time. Shravan (July–August) and Mahashivratri bring very large crowds.

faqs.question: Where does the tour start and end?
faqs.answer: The tour starts and ends in Indore.

faqs.question: Can the itinerary be customised?
faqs.answer: Yes. We can add or skip temples, change hotel categories, or extend your stay. Share your preferences when you enquire.

faqs.question: Is this tour suitable for senior citizens?
faqs.answer: Yes. Travel is by private vehicle and the pace is comfortable. Tell us about any mobility needs in advance.

faqs.question: Are special darshan tickets included?
faqs.answer: No, special darshan tickets are not included, but our team can help you book them where available.
